data.gender_notes: Ajai is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ajai is derived from the Sanskrit language and translates to ‘Not Born Yet’. This name was given to children who were born prematurely or whose parents had lost hope of having a child. The name Ajai carries the meaning “Not Born Yet” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ajai usually hope their child will grow to embody not born yet and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ajai total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

This name reflects the belief that a child is a gift from the gods and that even in the face of adversity, life continues to be a blessing.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ajai signifies the essence of creation and renewal. It signifies the belief that every life is a fresh beginning, regardless of the circumstances of its arrival. It also reflects the idea that life is full of possibilities and that we are all spiritual beings on a continuous journey of growth and transformation.
